ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Basics 16-Gauge Speaker Wire Cable, 100 Feet, 4-Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not setting up wired speakers, so this much speaker cable has no clear use for me.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so this older player feels redundant.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: SABRENT 4 Port USB 2.0 Data Hub with Individual LED lit Power Switches [Charging NOT Supported] for Mac & PC (HB-UMLS); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently need extra USB data ports, and it would not help with charging my devices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Seagate Expansion Desktop 12TB External Hard Drive HDD - USB 3.0 for PC Laptop (STEB12000400); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Video storage could be useful eventually, but I have no current need for a desktop drive this large.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Extra recording storage interests me, but I would check my camcorder's card requirements before choosing this.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Controlling a lamp through Alexa appeals to me because I already use Alexa-enabled Fire TV devices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: NETGEAR Nighthawk Smart Wi-Fi Router (R7000) - AC1900 Wireless Speed (Up to 1900 Mbps) | Up to 1800 Sq Ft Coverage & 30 Devices | 4 x 1G Ethernet and 2 USB ports | Armor Security; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A router serving my streaming devices and cameras is relevant, but I would only replace mine if I noticed connection problems.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Basics Keyboard and 3-Button USB Mouse Combo; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My monitor purchase alone does not give me a reason to replace my keyboard and mouse right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Kindle Paperwhite E-reader (Previous generation – 2015 release) - Black, 6" High-Resolution Display (300 ppi) with Built-in Light, Wi-Fi, Ad-Supported; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on home video and connected devices, and an e-reader does not meet a current need.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa and Dolby processing - Charcoal Fabric; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A hands-free Alexa speaker would be a useful addition for voice commands alongside my Fire TV devices.
